# Zoho Invoice

Zoho Invoice simplifies billing, recurring payments, and expense management, helping freelancers and small businesses send professional invoices

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/zoho-invoice/.

## Actions

- **Get Zoho Invoice Item** (read-only): Retrieve the details of a specific item by item id.
- **List Contacts**: List contacts.
- **List Expenses** (read-only): List all expenses with optional pagination.
- **List Invoices**: List invoices.
- **List Items** (read-only): List all items.
- **List Payments**: List payments.
